scope: Witness-only sensitivity aligned with PerturbCellRL v2 Appendix C velocity objective, on the released scDFM architecture and weights. No expression-support/pathway terms; no complete reproduction claim.
design_timing: Designed after previous custom population-NFT and native-FM test scores were viewed. New outcomes are not used to alter this recipe.

roles.calibration_exposure: These six conditions were present in released-checkpoint pretraining; they are excluded only from this additional fitting.

control_sampling: Eight iid draws with replacement per update; group ID denotes sampling event, including repeated physical cells.
precision: Autocast BF16 forward, FP32 master parameters, ODE state and loss operands; TF32 disabled.

nft.old_update: Exact live copy after each optimizer update
nft.objective: Eq57 velocity MSE, without adaptive clean reconstruction denominator
nft.reward: Euclidean witness excludes entire control event; generated readout clip>=0; real scale sqrt median squared pair distance; two group z scores, population std divisor8, reject zero std

native_control: Official scDFM affine Gaussian FM plus MMD(.5), plus the same weight1 original-reference velocity MSE; same real64 pool, 64 examples, two32 microbatches, LR, updates and eval EMA. It does not acquire unused generated trajectories, so FLOPs differ.
evaluation: All seven original held-out conditions; 128 independently generated cells and all original real cells per condition, published energy V including diagonal as primary. One fixed draw; no condition/hyperparameter selection.
deviations: Fixed64 real-reference cells per fitting condition chosen for matched finite label budget; paper permits available real reference responses.
Adam retained from scDFM; PerturbCellRL appendix does not specify optimizer identity.
Original author transductive5000/test1000 HVG preprocessing retained; continuation and readout use the author1000-HVG axis, released pretraining used5000.
FP32 master weights and BF16 autocast; native FM shares reference penalty as our matched control.
Our fixed18-fit/6-original-training-calibration split; calibration is not used to tune any coefficient.
One seed and one A549 context; no biological-replicate or cross-species claim.

resource_gate.revision_reason: Completed genuine CUDA probe projected99.2min; parent explicitly authorized100min before formal run, retaining all scientific settings.
